assertionSteps.title: 1. Given Admin A is authenticated as fixture UI-ADMIN-01 with the case-specific permissions

2. And the Category admin screen is open for UI-ADMIN-01; fixture record 101 is inactive and has Category Label Fixture Category; its owner is TEST_OWNER; the create response is a record with applicationCategoryId 102 and Category Label Changed Category

steps.title: Install clock "Thu Oct 22 2026 13:24:49 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"

assertionSteps.title: 3. When Admin A clicks button named "Create New Category" inside the "Category" administration tabpanel
4. And Admin A enters "Changed Category" into textbox named "Category Label" inside the new-record dialog inside the "Category" administration tabpanel
5. And Admin A enters "7" into spinbutton named "Order No" inside the new-record dialog inside the "Category" administration tabpanel
6. And the declared controlled field clock advances by 300 milliseconds
7. And Admin A clicks button named "Create" inside the new-record dialog inside the "Category" administration tabpanel
8. Then exactly one row with Record Id "102" exists in data grid with source identity "administration records" inside the "Category" administration tabpanel
9. And cell named "Category Label" inside row with Record Id "102" in the "Category" administration data grid displays "Changed Category"
